REQ-029.design_rationale: Section 2.1 updates agents/traceability-auditor.md and scripts/semantic_checker.py (validate_semantic_traceability) to evaluate architecturally_sound and debate_rationale. It rejects specifications that conflate agent/IDE tool limits with source-file size caps or fragment modules without trade-off justification, with backward-compatibility for legacy receipts lacking the field.
REQ-029.tasks_rationale: Task 1 updates agents/traceability-auditor.md and scripts/semantic_checker.py to validate architecturally_sound and debate_rationale. Task 6 covers unit tests in tests/test_spec_checker.py.
REQ-029.debate_rationale: ADR-020 directly addresses the root cause of the OpenKey incident where the auditor rubber-stamped a harmful file line-count rule. Incorporating architectural soundness checks into the existing auditor avoids doubling subagent dispatch latency while enforcing trade-off rigor before any code mutations begin.
REQ-029.evidence_rationale: verification.md Section 1 cites test_req029_adversarial_architectural_soundness_receipt in tests/test_spec_checker.py (PASSED). Verifies legacy receipts pass backward-compatibly, receipts with architecturally_sound: false or empty debate_rationale fail closed, and receipts with architecturally_sound: true and non-empty debate_rationale pass cleanly under pytest (60/60 passed).

REQ-030.design_rationale: Section 2.2 implements validate_adr_debate_structure() in scripts/spec_checker.py, called from validate_spec_package(). It inspects structured ADR sections (Context and Decision) for explicit Trade-offs & Risks and Rejected Alternatives markers, and enforces a hard line-count / file-splitting dogma guard when hard file line-count caps are proposed.
REQ-030.tasks_rationale: Task 2 implements validate_adr_debate_structure() in scripts/spec_checker.py and updates skills/spec-standard/SKILL.md and rules/spec-standard.md. Task 6 verifies via unit tests in tests/test_spec_checker.py.
REQ-030.debate_rationale: ADR-021 establishes deterministic, zero-latency verification of ADR debates. It scopes the requirement to multi-section structured ADRs and line-count caps to avoid breaking minimal 1-line unit test fixtures while strictly prohibiting unsubstantiated architectural dogmas.
REQ-030.evidence_rationale: verification.md Section 1 cites test_req030_validate_adr_debate_structure_and_anti_dogma in tests/test_spec_checker.py (PASSED). Verifies 1-line simple ADR fixtures pass, structured multi-section ADRs omitting Trade-offs & Risks or Rejected Alternatives are rejected, hard line-count cap dogmas without debate are rejected, and complete structured ADRs pass under pytest (60/60 passed).

REQ-031.design_rationale: Section 2.3 updates is_unauthorized_status_promotion() in scripts/spec-gate.py to track existing_approved_map and treat any change to req_range or key_decisions on an execution-authorized row as a scope expansion requiring recent user approval (has_recent_user_approval) and a valid traceability_audit.json matching the new spec_hash.
REQ-031.tasks_rationale: Task 3 implements the scope expansion check in scripts/spec-gate.py. Task 6 adds unit and security tests in tests/test_spec_gate.py and tests/test_spec_gate_security.py.
REQ-031.debate_rationale: ADR-022 closes the loophole where active specifications were expanded mid-flight to slip in unreviewed requirements without user approval or re-auditing, while deliberately permitting cosmetic edits to the title column.
REQ-031.evidence_rationale: verification.md Section 1 cites test_req031_mid_flight_index_scope_expansion_gated in tests/test_spec_gate_security.py (PASSED). Verifies title-only edits on approved rows remain permitted, expanding req_range or key_decisions without user approval or with missing/stale traceability_audit.json is denied, and expanding scope with both user approval and valid audit receipt is allowed.

REQ-032.design_rationale: Section 2.4 updates has_recent_user_approval() in scripts/spec-gate.py to find the last /goal turn in user_turns. It grants autonomous execution only when /goal is in user_turns[-1] or when every subsequent turn is an explicit continuation confirmation (proceed, approve, approved, yes, lgtm, continue), preventing eternal /goal bleed-over.
REQ-032.tasks_rationale: Task 4 updates has_recent_user_approval() in scripts/spec-gate.py. Task 6 adds unit tests covering single-turn /goal, multi-turn continuations, and non-approval prompt resets.
REQ-032.debate_rationale: ADR-023 balances the need for autonomous execution under /goal per RULE[explicit-approval] with strict session hygiene, ensuring that historical /goal prompts do not permanently bypass approval gating for subsequent, unrelated tasks.
REQ-032.evidence_rationale: verification.md Section 1 cites test_req032_scoped_goal_autonomous_approval_no_bleedover in tests/test_spec_gate_security.py (PASSED). Verifies /goal in the latest user turn returns True, /goal followed by continuation confirmations (proceed, yes) returns True, and /goal followed by a new question or /plan returns False.

REQ-033.design_rationale: Section 2.5 implements is_destructive_decisions_edit() in scripts/spec-gate.py. It blocks edits that delete existing ADR-\d+ identifiers from decisions.md across all specs, and for execution-authorized or terminal specs, blocks in-place rewrites of an ADR's - **Decision**: body while permitting status transitions to Superseded and appending new ADRs.
REQ-033.tasks_rationale: Task 5 implements is_destructive_decisions_edit() in scripts/spec-gate.py. Task 6 adds regression tests in tests/test_spec_gate.py and tests/test_spec_gate_security.py.
REQ-033.debate_rationale: ADR-024 mechanically enforces the append-only invariant on architectural decision records, preventing historical revisionism and silent deletion of superseded constraints while preserving drafting ergonomics for pre-approval drafts.
REQ-033.evidence_rationale: verification.md Section 1 cites test_req033_append_only_decisions_md_enforced in tests/test_spec_gate_security.py (PASSED). Verifies deleting existing ADR-\d+ identifiers is denied, in-place rewrites of the - **Decision**: body in approved/completed specs are denied, and marking Status: Superseded by ADR-xxx while appending a new ADR block is allowed.
